title: Design spec (40-design-spec.json)
description: Design → Engineer. The complete visual contract: every screen resolves to Figma nodes, system components, and token paths. Nothing visual exists outside this document.

storyId.description: The product-spec story this screen implements

figma.description: The exact Figma source QA compares the build against

components.description: Component names from design-focx / design-connect, e.g. 'connect/Button/primary'

tokensSynced.description: True when this run updated design/tokens/ from Figma (manifest lastSync must match)

designSystemGaps.description: Needs Figma does not yet publish. Non-empty gaps that block a story mean escalation, not improvisation. Empty array = no gaps.
